title: Bathroom
note: Bathroom pack (tools/make_bathroom_assets.py). The size (dimensions_m) comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

bathroom_kind.label: Piece
bathroom_kind.note: Which piece: toilet, pedestal_sink, bathtub_alcove, bathtub_freestanding, shower_stall, vanity_single, vanity_double, medicine_cabinet, vanity_mirror, linen_cabinet, towel_shelf, hamper, towel_stack, bath_mat, towel_bar, tp_holder, hook_rail or soap_set.

color.label: Colour
color.note: The glaze of a fixture, the wood of a cabinet, the fabric of a towel or mat, or the metal finish of an accessory.

water_per_use_l.label: Water per use (L)
water_per_use_l.note: Litres one use takes (a flush, a basin, a bath, a shower).

water_usage_lpm.label: Water flow (L/min)
water_usage_lpm.note: Litres per minute while running; 0 for a dry piece.
